display.purpose: Net worth and dashboard headline numbers only.

headline.purpose: Section-level money figures and onboarding headers.

title.purpose: Card titles, sheet titles, list item names.

label.purpose: Structural uppercase data labels — never prose.

motion.name: ease-standard
motion.purpose: Default easing for state transitions and sheet slides.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The single main action on a screen or sheet.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: #1B7F5F; color: #ffffff; border: none; border-radius: 12px; padding: 14px 20px; font-family: system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0; transition: opacity 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { opacity: 0.9; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #1B7F5F; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Outlined Button
components.css: .ds-btn-outlined { background: transparent; color: #1B7F5F; border: 1px solid rgba(27, 127, 95, 0.5); border-radius: 12px; padding: 12px 16px; font-family: system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600; transition: background 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1); } .ds-btn-outlined:hover { background: rgba(27, 127, 95, 0.08); } .ds-btn-outlined:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #1B7F5F; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Card
components.css: .ds-card { background: #F1F5F4; border-radius: 16px; padding: 16px; font-family: system-ui, sans-serif; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 6px; } .ds-card-label { font-size: 12px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.4px; text-transform: uppercase; color: #68766F; } .ds-card-value { font-size: 22px; font-weight: 800; letter-spacing: -0.4px; color: #1A211F; }

components.name: Insight Banner
components.html:
Budget warning
Food is 15% over your monthly cap.
components.css: .ds-banner { background: rgba(217, 119, 6, 0.08); border: 1px solid rgba(217, 119, 6, 0.25); border-radius: 12px; padding: 14px; display: flex; gap: 10px; align-items: flex-start; font-family: system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-banner-title { font-size: 13px; font-weight: 700; color: #D97706; } .ds-banner-detail { font-size: 12px; line-height: 1.4; color: #27302D; }

components.name: Wallet Balance Card
components.description: Compact horizontal wallet tile with brand-colored logo chip.
components.css: .ds-wallet { background: #F1F5F4; border-radius: 14px; padding: 12px; width: 130px; display: flex; gap: 8px; align-items: center; font-family: system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-wallet-logo { background: #0033A0; color: #ffffff; border-radius: 8px; padding: 4px 8px; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 700; } .ds-wallet-name { font-size: 12px; font-weight: 600; color: #1A211F; } .ds-wallet-balance { font-size: 14px; font-weight: 700; color: #1A211F; }

components.name: Chip
components.css: .ds-chip { background: rgba(167, 175, 171, 0.6); border-radius: 999px; padding: 8px 12px; font-family: system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 12px; color: #27302D; }

components.name: Input Field
components.description: Filled text field with muted prefix icon.
components.css: .ds-input { background: rgba(167, 175, 171, 0.4); border-radius: 12px; padding: 14px; display: flex; gap: 8px; align-items: center; font-family: system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-input input { border: none; background: transparent; font-size: 14px; color: #1A211F; outline: none; width: 100%; } .ds-input:focus-within { outline: 2px solid #1B7F5F; outline-offset: -2px; }

narrative.overview:
Finance Tracker looks the way a well-kept ledger feels: calm, precise, and honest. The interface is a Material 3 surface system seeded from one deep green — a quiet signal that money is being handled carefully, not a marketing color. Nothing shouts; hierarchy comes from weight, size, and spacing, and color appears only where it means something: income, overspend, warnings, brand.

The system is tonal, not outlined. Surfaces are distinguished by subtle lightness steps, and borders appear only when they carry meaning — a selected state, a warning, a wallet's brand color. Depth is flat by design: no shadows, no elevation theater; the screen reads as a single calm document.

The personality is restrained and quiet. Buttons are confident but unadorned. Typography leads — tight, bold numbers for balances, small-caps labels for structure, and generous whitespace between groups. The result should feel like a well-maintained record book, not a banking app's dashboard.
keyCharacteristics: One accent color, used sparingly; everything else is tonal gray-green
Flat, borderless surfaces; borders are semantic, not decorative
Numbers carry the page — big, bold, tabular, peso-formatted
Quiet motion: 150-280ms ease-out transitions, never attention-seeking
Material 3 components, but tamed: no shadows, no gradients, no glass

rules.name: The One Green Rule
rules.body: Verdant Ledger is the only accent color on any screen. Amber and red appear only when the data demands them. If a screen has three accent colors, something is wrong.

rules.name: The Meaningful Border Rule
rules.body: A border only exists to carry meaning — selection, warning, or a wallet's brand color. Never draw a border as decoration around a resting card.

rules.name: The Number-First Rule
rules.body: When a screen shows a money figure, the number is the largest thing on it. Labels explain the number; they never compete with it.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: Surfaces are flat at rest. If a future component needs a shadow, it must earn it by being genuinely floating (a menu, a tooltip) — and even then it should be a soft offset blur, never a hard halo.

dos: Do lead every data screen with its number, biggest and boldest.
Do use 12-16px radii, 16px card padding, and the 12px spacing rhythm — never invent new sizes for the same component class.
Do put the one primary action in a filled Verdant Ledger button and everything else outlined.
Do keep motion to 150-280ms ease-out transitions on state changes only.
Do use the official bank/e-wallet SVG logos wherever a wallet appears (picker, card, dropdown).
donts: Don't add shadows, gradients, glass, or decorative borders — depth is tonal layering, nothing else.
Don't use accent colors for decoration; Verdant Ledger is for money-in and action, Overdraft Red for money-out and danger, Warn Amber for warnings only.
Don't stack cards inside cards — one container per surface level.
Don't place text over a bank logo; logos sit on neutral surfaces with padding.
Don't invent kickers above headings — the heading carries its own weight; uppercase labels are for data, not titles.
